answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. Audits are published in canyon, queued in anchor, and juniper publishes the wait time. A farm of 299 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 994 identities would post 4333 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
